hypothesis: Hostname allowlist checks in isExternalCdn and isSupabaseAuth use substring matching (url.hostname.includes) without trailing-dot normalization or apex/subdomain suffix verification, allowing lookalike domains such as cdn-cloudinary.com.example or custom-supabase.co.example to match route predicates.

The NetworkOnly API exclusion rule in sw.ts matches only /api/trips/ (with trailing slash) and three auth/cloudinary/receipt prefixes. Same-origin GET requests without a trailing slash such as /api/trips, /api/users/me/preferences, and /api/app/donation-progress fall through into @serwist/next defaultCache 'apis' NetworkFirst storage, persisting user-specific JSON across account switches.

The BackgroundSyncPlugin runtimeCaching entry in sw.ts omits the Serwist method property, so Serwist Route defaults to HTTP method GET while the matcher filters for POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE. Meanwhile the live offline write path uses IndexedDB SyncQueue with dynamic JWT refresh and 401 pause protection. Removing the unreachable route requires Chesterton archaeology confirmation.

In push and notificationclick handlers, rawLink validation checks startsWith('/') and !startsWith('//') without normalizing backslash characters (/\example.com) or control bytes, and client matching uses client.url.includes(self.location.origin) rather than URL origin equality.

createSerwistRoute scans public/**/* without excluding public/sw.js and public/sw.js.map in globIgnores, causing the generated sw.js bundle to embed stale prior-build hashes of sw.js and sw.js.map inside self.__SW_MANIFEST.

.gitignore excludes .agent/ and .worktrees/ but does not ignore .agents/teamwork/, leaving temporary multi-agent scratch files untracked yet stageable in git status until AD-151 4-layer hygiene defense is enforced across .gitignore, push workflow, and sentinel tests.
